title: Deletion Back-Dating Allowances by Removal Reason, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Schedule
content:
For a vehicle removed from a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the deletion back-dating allowance, a number of calendar days, follows the removal reason on the removal entry.

| Removal reason on the removal entry | Deletion back-dating allowance |
|---|---|
| The vehicle was declared a total loss | 60 days |
| The vehicle was sold | 30 days |
| Any other reason | Nil |

## Notes

- The reason is the one recorded on the vehicle removal entry in the policy's transaction history.

## Reading the schedule

- A removal entry whose reason reads sold carries an allowance of 30 days.
- A removal entry whose reason reads total loss carries an allowance of 60 days.
- A removal entry with any other reason carries an allowance of nil.
